name: Yashuma
source:
The eldest son of [url=/c52570]Ozen[/url], owlo of Kujyuri. As the second-born of his siblings, he is older than [url=/c37790]Rulutieh[/url], but younger than [url=/c52066]Shis[/url]. He is a polite young man, and he has an aura of comfort about him, but he is no match for his older sister.
